entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I help you today?
I'm calling about an exercise bike I just received. It's completely broken!
I'm so sorry to hear that you're having trouble with your new VeloFit exercise bike. Can you describe what's wrong?
Well, for starters, the frame is cracked! A completely cracked frame! I can't even believe you shipped something in this condition.
I understand your frustration. A cracked frame is certainly not acceptable. I apologize for the inconvenience. Was there any visible shipping damage to the box?
The box was a little beat up, yes, but I didn't think anything of it! Now I see why. And the wheel... the front wheel is completely wobbly! It's practically unusable!

Okay, a wobbly wheel and a cracked frame. That sounds like significant damage. I sincerely apologize for the condition in which you received your VeloFit bike. To resolve this, I can offer you a full refund. We'll also provide a free label for you to ship the bike back to us.
A refund? That's it? I wanted to start using this thing today! I don't want a refund, I want a working bike! I spent good money on this.

I understand. Unfortunately, due to the extent of the damage, a replacement might not be readily available. But the free label will allow you to easily ship the defective unit back without any expense. The refund will be processed as soon as we receive the item.
So you're saying I'm stuck waiting again? Waiting for you to ship something, waiting for it to arrive broken, and now waiting for you to process a return? This is ridiculous!
I understand your frustration, sir/madam. Is there anything else I can do to make things right? I can also offer you a discount code for a future purchase. Would that be helpful?
A discount code? Seriously? After all this? This is just insulting. I’m going to take my business elsewhere. This is the worst customer service I've ever experienced.
I am truly sorry for the negative experience. We value your business and hope to have another chance to serve you in the future. I am issuing the free label now and...
